product.title: Hike the native Pericu road in Sierra de la Laguna.

description.text: In Cabo San Lucas, this guided hike follows a Pericu route in the Sierra de la Laguna reserve, then sits down to a California rancho meal of handmade tortillas and rancho cheese. The published walk covers about four miles through semitropical desert, with a swim hole when water is present and a later stargazing window on the return when the group finishes after dark. Hotel transfers and the reserve entrance fee are included; the group is capped at eight. The meeting point is the McDonald's lot on Blvd. Lázaro Cárdenas. The format suits visitors who want an Indigenous-history trail day without finding the canyon independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Cabo San Lucas, and the itinerary stays on the Sierra de la Laguna, Pericu trail, and rancho that shape this outing.
